sentences.en: Ataturk died in 1938, but he still is widely venerated.

sentences.en: Which country was led by Kemal Ataturk?

sentences.en: Turkey's first president Kemal Ataturk dedicated November 24 to honour teachers and their profession.

sentences.en: I wasn't in Ataturk but that's the best I've ever seen.

sentences.en: When Turkish President Kemal Ataturk turned it into a museum in 1935, Christian mosaics covered up by the Muslims were revealed.

sentences.en: Kemal Ataturk, Turkish general, statesman and President, was born at Salonika in Greece.

sentences.en: Even Ataturk, the president of the new Republic of Turkey sent a delegation out of respect. We washed his body.

sentences.en: They have always seen themselves as the guardians of the modern secular state founded by Mustafa Kemal Ataturk in the 1920s.
